body:
Deepseek

Based on the screenshots, here’s a clear breakdown of the Food Vibe system and how the weekly payout works.

---

🧾 Group Overview

· Food Vibe is a WhatsApp community focused on sharing food experiences (meals, shopping, cooking, etc.).
· It’s part of the larger community “Provo 42 – LEAF NODES”.
· The group has a paid structure, intended to become a regular contract job in the future.
· Rules: take meal pics/videos, avoid personally identifiable information (faces, text, reflections, etc.), and most importantly – have fun.

---

💰 Weekly Pot & Points

· Weekly pot: starts at €4.20 (may grow as community expands).
· Every member gets 1 point just for being active.
· Additional points are earned based on contribution level:

Level Points
Member 1
Small 2
Medium 3
Large 4

· Contribution is judged by one person (who also judges their own contributions, at least initially).
· Points are awarded per week, not per photo. The total pot is divided proportionally among all members based on their points.

---

📊 Payout Example (from the Kimi screenshot)

Member Level Points Payout (€)
Alice Large 4 2.40
Bob Small 2 1.20
Carol Member 1 0.60

· Total members: 3
· Total points: 7
· Value per point: €4.20 / 7 = €0.60
· Total distributed: €4.20 (fully allocated)

---

🍽️ Real‑life examples in the chat

· A dinner order from thuisbezorgd.nl was paid via an electronic gift card bought with Bitcoin (total €32, service/delivery fees, voucher -€11.70, tip €3).
· Breakfast in a crisis ward – only cheese and spreads available.
· The group was recently restarted with the intention of making it a paid contract.

---

🧠 Potential things to keep in mind

· The point system relies on subjective evaluation (one person decides). As the group grows, a more transparent or democratic system might be needed.
· The weekly pot is small for now, but could scale.
· Because payments are mentioned (Bitcoin, Thuisbezorgd), and the group is part of a larger “LEAF NODES” community, there may be a crypto or blockchain angle – though not explicitly detailed.

---

If you need help setting up a similar system, calculating distributions, or have any specific questions about the rules, just let me know!
